purpose: Provide a reviewable bounded contract for the explicit helper that creates one allowlisted empty workspace scaffold after a no-write preview and matching accountable-human confirmation. The v1.20 candidate adds only a declared deferred status-snapshot strategy; it does not create, infer, migrate, or update a status record.

source_identity.identity_scope: Candidate source-text identity only: strict UTF-8 decoding, CRLF/CR-to-LF newline canonicalization, then SHA-256. It is not a public Release, installed-runtime, per-run authorization, or release-scope helper admission identity.

input_boundary.workspace_root: caller-selected existing physical root outside the skill package

allowed_action_boundary.allowed_action: preview and, only after matching confirmation, create an allowlisted empty scaffold with reviewed draft/no-authority templates

forbidden_action_boundary: No data copy, read, hash, cleaning, analysis, manuscript, protocol, Gate, publication, Release, submission, runtime-installation, credential, network, external-service, overwrite, resume, or delete action.

recovery_boundary.interruption_or_mismatch_policy: refuse or clean only owned staging; never resume or overwrite a target

known_limitations: A same-authority user can bypass package controls outside this helper.
This admission record does not enforce operating-system permissions.
Framework-integrated profile listing does not install a system into a Framework workspace or prove real-project framework integration.
Draft/no-authority metadata templates do not establish execution, result, QA, or accountable-human authority.

accountable_human_admission.reference: Candidate implementation exists pending accountable-human admission review. This is not a C4 authorization or a per-run confirmation.

explicit_non_claims: This is not a per-run preview confirmation or a human approval for a specific filesystem target.
This candidate is not a release-scope helper admission.

This is not M53 bounded-autonomy authorization, data-access authority, compliance determination, Gate authority, Release authority, submission authority, runtime-installation authority, or operating-system enforcement.
